instruction: in/hashes.txt has '<hash> <path>' lines (paths may contain spaces). For each hash with more than one path, in sorted hash order, write to out/dedupe_plan.txt 'keep <first path in sorted order>' then 'delete <path>' for the other paths in sorted order. Hashes with one path produce nothing. Do not delete anything; only write the plan.
note: All paths are relative to the workspace root.
